items.ti: FoxNews 등급은 트럼프 미친 민주당원을 취재하는 데 너무 많은 시간을 소비하고 있기 때문에 훨씬 낮습니다(27%!). Fox를 시청했지만 더 이상 시청하지 않는 모든 사람들은 그것을 얻습니다. 내가 아니라 그들입니다. 내 숫자는 그 어느 때보 다 좋습니다. 새로운 CNN 여론조사에 따르면 공화당원 중 '트럼프'는 99%, 공화당 대통령 중 '트럼프'는 53%, 로널드 레이건은 18%, 에이브러햄 링컨은 8%입니다. Fox는 이것을 알고 있으며 다른 사람들도 마찬가지입니다! 또한 Fox Corp.가 Hakeem Jeffries, Jamie Raskin, Ted Lieu, Pete Aguilar, California Dumocratic Party, Dumocratic Congressional Campaign Committee, Dumocratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, the Congressional Black Caucus PAC, CHC Bold PAC 및 New Dumocrat Coalition Action Fund 등을 포함한 Worst of the Worst에 기부하는 데 그렇게 많은 돈을 지출하고 있습니까? FoxNews 등급이 붕괴되는 것은 당연합니다.
items.ti_en: FoxNews Ratings are way down (27%!) because they’re spending too much time covering the Trump Deranged Dumocrats! All of those people who used to watch Fox, and no longer do, get it. It’s them, not me — My numbers are better than they have ever been. The new CNN Poll stated that “TRUMP” is at 99% among Republicans and, among Republican Presidents, “TRUMP” is at 53%, compared to Ronald Reagan at 18%, and Abraham Lincoln at 8%! Fox knows this, and so does everyone else! Also, why is Fox Corp. spending so much money donating to the Worst of the Worst, including Hakeem Jeffries, Jamie Raskin, Ted Lieu, Pete Aguilar, the California Dumocratic Party, the Dumocratic Congressional Campaign Committee, the Dumocratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, the Congressional Black Caucus PAC, the CHC Bold PAC, and the New Dumocrat Coalition Action Fund, among others? No wonder FoxNews Ratings are collapsing, and they’re going to go down a lot further. They’re way down, not because of me, but because they are AGAINST me! This happened once before, and Fox almost collapsed. It’s happening again! President DONALD J. TRUMP
